description: This Kotlin source file defines a RecyclerView adapter class 'NotificationsAdapter' used for displaying a list of notifications in the Android frontend of an online shopping platform. The adapter manages multiple view types (headers and notification items), handles binding data to views, and provides utility functions for interaction.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter extending RecyclerView.Adapter to render sectioned notification list with headers and items, supporting click interactions.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter.Row
classes.description: Sealed class representing a row in the adapter, either a Header or an Item.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter.Header
classes.description: Data class representing header sections categorized by time buckets.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter.Item
classes.description: Data class representing individual notification items.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter.HeaderVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for header views, binds section header text.

classes.name: NotificationsAdapter.ItemVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for notification items, binds notification data to views including icon, message, timestamp, and handles click events.

methods.name: submitRows
methods.description: Replaces the current list of rows with a new list and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: getRowAt
methods.description: Returns the row at a specific adapter position.

methods.name: findAdapterPositionForNotificationId
methods.description: Finds the adapter position of a notification based on its ID.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the row at a given position.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type (header or item) for a given position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances for headers and items based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolders for headers and items.
